scope: Historical REFERENCE_M1 route mechanics only; no evaluator scores, target criteria, or target-success labels used.

legacy_verifier_semantics.conditions: Only eq operators; every condition must have a present case value equal to the literal.
legacy_verifier_semantics.order: Validate policy and baselines; require trace input IDs unique and present in case map; evaluate stop and selector matches; reject multiple/conflicting matches; require exact route type/rule/action fields; fallback requires null rule/action.
